father_study_root.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Ah, there you are! Lovely day for a little music, isn't it?

father_study_music.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: An old melody. Funny how a tune can find its way home.

father_study_melody.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Oh, here and there. Some things are older than they look.

father_study_questions.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Of course, kiddo. What is it?

father_study_house.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Mother does like everything in its proper place. Even the little drawers have their arrangements.

father_study_marks.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Just a little pattern she uses. Once you've seen it, it's difficult not to notice it everywhere.

father_study_watchers.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Mother is fond of those dolls. Always placing them where they can see everything.

father_study_blind.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Oh! Not everything, of course. They have to face the right way. Walls get in the way, too.

father_study_machines.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Mother has clever machines working behind the scenes.

father_study_gifts.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: They make sure the presents and surprises arrive where they ought to. Quite an arrangement, really.

father_study_workshop.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: I like making things. Especially when they make someone smile.

father_study_world.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: The garden is lovely. Beyond it? Some places have been forgotten for a very long time.

father_study_trees.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: You'd be surprised how empty some of those perfect trees are inside.

father_study_family.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Mother does like things perfect. Best not to disturb her arrangements.

father_study_kindness.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: A kind word. A quiet evening. A family sitting down together.

father_study_wybie.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: A helpful fellow. Sometimes quiet is how someone stays out of trouble.

father_study_hesitate.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: I don't think she'd want me discussing that. Best not to worry yourself.

father_study_uncomfortable.direction: Warm, absent-minded and gently hesitant; never openly defiant.
lines: Oh, I really must get back to my music now, kiddo.
